adapterBoundary.nativeWrites: native preview, operation allow-list, execute, exact confirm and durable journal

discovery.help:
tenable-axi card list [--limit <n>]
Artium manages both API keys and the fixed https://cloud.tenable.com origin. Writes and export-job creation require administrator-enabled operations, preview, --execute and exact --confirm. File inputs accept uploaded leaves or explicit stdin (-). Downloads and local configuration are blocked.
